wake-of-gods.mapobjects.altar-of-transfo: Transforms eligible troops into creatures of the same tier. Once per hero per week for a paid transformation. Named destination: 1,000 gold and 500 movement points; Random: 500 gold and 500 movement points. Bring at least 1,000 gold and 500 movement points to open the menu.

{Altar of Transformation}

You have heard of these mysterious altars in old tales--their power can transform almost any creature to another one.

Slowly you near the altar and stop a few steps away, close enough to manipulate the energy, but not so close that you risk transforming yourself.

Choose one of the nine factions or Neutral (1,000 gold and 500 movement points), or entrust the fate of your army to chance (500 gold and 500 movement points). Random chooses one of the ten destinations for the whole army and may leave it unchanged. Leaving or choosing a named destination that requires no transformation costs nothing.

{Altar of Transformation}

You climb to the top of the altar but the energy merely sputters around you as if it had recently been drained. Try again next week.

{Altar of Transformation}

You approach the ancient stones, but cannot yet call upon their power. Bring at least 1,000 gold, 500 movement points and troops that the altar can transform. You leave without losing anything.
